body:
Reviewed exact PR #118 head 0b8df1c8cb067a8e8249887925bb1f4b96948184 as Student B/book6349, assisted by Codex GPT-6 Sol. I checked the one-line restoration of the trimmed-title lower bound, the four reported-case tests (empty/whitespace rejected with title detail and unchanged records; valid 1/120 titles created and reloaded), and unchanged assertions through the repeat RED. History shows aed4be8 committed actual 2-fail/2-pass RED while the rule was still faulty, before final fix 3d6f087. The first fix preceded its RED evidence commit; that process deviation is disclosed and preserved, not called compliant or rewritten. The current head differs from tested 3d6f087 only in docs/evidence; existing app tests, auth, schema and workflow remain unchanged. I independently verified 12/12 received D payload hashes and 56/56 correction evidence hashes.

My exact-head checks on a fresh, loopback-only classpulse_test cluster: `npm test -- tests/api/uat6TitleRegression.test.ts` 4 passed/0 failed/0 skipped; full server `npm test` 143/0/0 across 17 files; client `npm test` 1/0/0; both `npm run build` passed. The cluster is stopped. `git diff --check` reports preserved evidence/log whitespace and blank EOF lines; I found no application-source issue in those warnings. Required CI run 45783244281 is SUCCESS for this head; its server, client, browser and Docker job steps succeeded. I did not run browser or Docker locally.

Approving this corrected feature for merge-commit integration into sprint-2-staging only. This is not approval to deploy latest S2: its later Lab7 runtime/schema were outside D's exercised version. Proposed release order remains separate: after cross-chat coordination, recheck original S1 ref/rules/ancestry and exact diff before any guarded fast-forward to this reviewed corrected feature SHA, then separately review the S1-to-main release and verify the deployed image/revision before independent retest. No S1/main/Cloud change is authorized by this review. D drafts 3/6/9 remain preserved; C's review, corrected deployment, independent retest, Part D and final acceptance remain pending.
